## Flow-by-Flow Findings

### Flow 1 — Launch → Version Check → Level Map

**Status: Connected**

| Step | Screen/Route | Real logic? |
|------|-------------|-------------|
| App cold launch | `SplashScreen` (M-01) | `BootstrapController.run()` calls `GET /v1/version/minimum` then `GET /v1/auth/session`. Spinner shown during network call; error state with retry on network failure. |
| Version check | `GET /v1/version/minimum` (backend) | Reads `settings.minimum_app_version`, compares installed version using semver utility, records `force_upgrade_shown` analytics event. Returns real `MinimumVersionResponse`. |
| Force upgrade | `ForceUpgradeScreen` (M-02) → App Store/Play Store URL | Fully blocks navigation. "Update Now" CTA deep-links to `app_store_url` / `play_store_url` from the API response. No bypass. |
| Version OK + session present | `SplashScreen` routes to `HomeShell` (M-11) | `BootstrapPhase.ready` branch pushes `Routes.home` with `HomeArgs`. |
| Version OK + no session | `SplashScreen` routes to `WelcomeScreen` (M-03) | `BootstrapPhase.unauthenticated` branch. |

**Wiring:** `SplashScreen` → `ForceUpgradeScreen` (blocked dead-end as intended) or `WelcomeScreen` or `HomeShell`. All branches present and reachable.

### Flow 2 — First-Time Sign-Up (Google/Apple/Phone → Age → VPC if <13 → Privacy → Map)

**Status: Connected**

#### OAuth sub-path (Google / Apple)

| Step | Screen/Route | Real logic? |
|------|-------------|-------------|
| Welcome | `WelcomeScreen` (M-03) | Buttons wire to Google Sign-In / Sign in with Apple SDK flows or phone path. |
| OAuth token exchange | `POST /v1/auth/oauth` | Verifies provider token server-side via `verifier_for(provider).verify(id_token)`; creates or restores `User` record; returns `next_step` for onboarding routing. |
| Name + age capture | `ProfileCompletionScreen` → `POST /v1/auth/profile` | Stores name and age on the `User` record; applies `is_under_13` flag; emits `age_gate_triggered` analytics event when applicable. |
| Age routing | `age_gate.dart` | Client-side routing off `next_step` from server; no client-side age logic. |
| Age ≥ 13 | → `PrivacyTermsScreen` (M-08) | Direct path. |
| Age < 13 | → `ParentGateScreen` (M-06) | Hard block — no bypass path in navigation. |

#### VPC Path A (under-13, parent OAuth)

| Step | Screen/Route | Real logic? |
|------|-------------|-------------|
| Parent gate | `ParentGateScreen` (M-06) | Presents two VPC path options. |
| Parent OAuth | `ParentOauthScreen` (M-06A) | Triggers Google/Apple sign-in with a forced account picker; passes parent ID token to next screen. |
| Parent attestation | `ParentAttestationScreen` (M-06B) | `POST /v1/consent/parent-oauth/complete` — server verifies parent's OAuth token, confirms parent account ≠ child account, records `ParentalConsentRecord`, activates child account. Attestation form fields validated server-side (both consent checkboxes required). HANDOFF H-4: legal copy text is placeholder pending counsel review; the mechanism is real. |
| Child profile | `ChildProfileScreen` (M-06C) | Name and optional mobile captured; part of the same `POST /v1/consent/parent-oauth/complete` payload. |
| Child privacy notice | `ChildNoticeScreen` (M-07) | `POST /v1/consent/child-notice/acknowledge` — stamps `child_notice_acknowledged_at` on both `User` and `ParentalConsentRecord`. |

#### VPC Path B (under-13, email verification)

| Step | Screen/Route | Real logic? |
|------|-------------|-------------|
| Parent email entry | `ParentEmailScreen` (M-06D) | `POST /v1/consent/email/request` — rate-limited (60 s cooldown, max 5/day); issues signed single-use token; sends email via `email_client`. |
| Awaiting verification | `AwaitingEmailScreen` (M-06E) | Polls `GET /v1/consent/status` every 5 s; shows "Resend email" (60 s cooldown); "Use Google/Apple instead" routes to Path A. Cannot skip. |
| Parent web confirmation | `GET/POST /consent/verify/{token}` (M-06F, web) | HTML page served by FastAPI. GET renders form with child name, privacy link, and expiry countdown. POST validates name + consent checkbox, calls `consent_service.grant_consent()`, emits `vpc_email_verified` and `parental_consent_completed` analytics events. Token single-use; 72-hour expiry enforced. |

#### Common tail

| Step | Screen/Route | Real logic? |
|------|-------------|-------------|
| Privacy / ToS | `PrivacyTermsScreen` (M-08) | `POST /v1/auth/privacy-accept` — requires `accepted: true`; under-13 path also gates on `account_status == CONSENTED`; stamps `privacy_accepted_at` and `privacy_policy_version`; emits `sign_up_completed` + audit event. |
| Level map | `HomeShell` / `LevelMapScreen` (M-11) | `next_step == null` routes to `Routes.home`. |

**Wiring:** Every screen in the sign-up sequence routes to the next step via `next_step` from the server. No screen dead-ends mid-flow.

### Flow 4 — Main Gameplay (Level Select → Server Attempt → Pass/Fail → Ad if 13+ → Next/IAP)

**Status: Connected**

| Step | Screen/Route | Real logic? |
|------|-------------|-------------|
| Level map | `LevelMapScreen` (M-11) | `GET /v1/game/levels` — queries real `Level` and `LevelCompletion` tables; computes IAP lock state server-side using `has_unlock`; returns `playable` flag from live question pool counts. |
| Level detail | `LevelDetailScreen` (M-12) | `GET /v1/game/levels/{n}` — reads DB, returns real timer/difficulty/pool data. |
| Start attempt | `GameplayScreen` (M-13) → `POST /v1/game/levels/{n}/attempts/start` | Server draws 10 questions from live approved+active pool (§18H mix rules); creates `LevelAttempt`; returns questions **without** correct answers. Rate-limited by user and install ID. Enforces level-unlock gate. |
| Per-answer validation | `POST /v1/game/attempts/{id}/answers` | Server validates: sequence integrity, answer correctness, per-question time floor (800 ms) and ceiling (`timer_seconds × 1000 + 2000 ms`), total attempt duration. Wrong answer → `status = failed` immediately; no partial credit. Client never computes score. |
| Timer expired | `POST /v1/game/attempts/{id}/timer-expired` | Server marks attempt `failed`, emits `timer_expired` + `level_failed` analytics. Routes to `LevelFailScreen` (M-16 copy). |
| Level fail | `LevelFailScreen` (M-15/M-16) | "Try again" navigates back to `LevelDetailScreen`, allowing a fresh `start_attempt` call. Answers not revealed. |
| Level pass | `LevelCompleteScreen` (M-14) | Score sourced from `SubmitAnswerResponse.score` (server-computed); `userRank` from server. `adEligible` flag set server-side: `ads_allowed_for_user(user) AND level_id >= ad_min_level`. |
| Ad break | `AdBreakScreen` (M-21) | Session counters (`adsShownThisSession`, `levelsCompletedThisSession`) enforced client-side; server withholds ad unit IDs entirely for under-13 accounts. AdMob SDK never initialised for under-13. HANDOFF H-3: live ad-account COPPA audit deferred. |
| Next level locked | → `IapUnlockScreen` (M-22) | `nextLevelLocked` from server response. |
| Next level unlocked | → `HomeShell` (M-11) | Map reloads with updated progress. |

### Flow 10 — Admin Content Publish (Track A via SQLAdmin)

**Status: Connected**

> Admin flows are evaluated independently from mobile flows per instructions. The admin dashboard is a separate SQLAdmin surface mounted at `/admin`, structurally isolated from the user-facing `/v1/*` router tree. No admin screen ID shares a URL prefix with any mobile API route.

#### Admin route separation

| Surface | Path prefix | Auth |
|---------|-------------|------|
| Mobile API | `/v1/*` | JWT bearer token (user session) |
| Admin dashboard | `/admin/*` | Session cookie (AdminUser email + password via `AdminAuth`) |

Separation is enforced at the router level — `admin.mount("/admin", app=admin_app)` is separate from `app.include_router(v1_router, prefix="/v1")`. No shared middleware leaks admin auth into user routes or vice versa.

#### Per-screen assessment

| ID | SQLAdmin resource / view | Real logic? |
|----|--------------------------|-------------|
| A-01 | `AdminAuth` (SQLAdmin built-in) | Queries `AdminUser` table; bcrypt password comparison; session cookie with `ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET`. Production boot guard rejects placeholder secrets. |
| A-02 | `ReportsView` KPI cards | Real SQL: DAU (distinct users in last 24 h from `AnalyticsEvent`), total users, live question count, IAP unlocks, leaderboard entries, pending consents, content version. |
| A-03 | `BibleCharacterAdmin` | Full CRUD against `BibleCharacter` table. Bulk delete. Filter by level. |
| A-04 | `BibleCharacterAdmin` edit view | `on_model_change` blocks save if `image_asset_key` set without `image_alt_text`. Logs `admin_character_created/updated`. Enforces `review_status` on character. |
| A-05 | `QuestionAdmin` | Searchable/filterable list. `approve_questions` and `activate_questions` bulk actions; activate silently skips unapproved questions (review gate cannot be bypassed). |
| A-06 | `QuestionAdmin` edit view | Validates 4 options, correct-answer match, verse_clue fields, image alt text, `active` gated on `review_status == approved`. |
| A-07 | `LevelAdmin` + `ContentPublishView` | Level CRUD (no delete — 100 levels fixed for v1). **Publish content** action: `content_pack.publish()` validates per-level pool health (beta and launch bars), bumps monotonic `content_version`, writes `ContentPublishRecord`, builds gzipped practice pack. Validation failure returns error; success writes audit event and analytics event. |
| A-08 | `UserAdmin` list | Masked mobile column (`_mask_mobile`). Read-only (no create/edit). |
| A-09 | `UserAdmin` delete | Calls `accounts.delete_account()` — not a plain ORM delete. Same hard-delete + anonymize path as in-app deletion. Audit trail written. |
| A-10 | `ReportsView` tabbed reports | 7 real report builders: `dau_trend`, `level_funnel`, `vpc_funnel`, `iap_conversion`, `ad_impressions`, `leaderboard_engagement`, `content_pool_health`. All query real `AnalyticsEvent` or entity tables with SQL aggregations. Date-range picker. UTC labels. |
| A-11 | `ReportsView` CSV export | `StreamingResponse` with real CSV rows from the same report builders. Audit event written on every export. PDF deferred post-v1 per inference IA-10. |
| A-12 | `AuditLogAdmin` | Read-only `AuditLog` table (immutable: `can_create = can_edit = can_delete = False`). CSV export via `AuditLogExportView`. |
| A-13 | `AdminUserAdmin` | Change password (password hash never rendered). Single-admin assumed for v1; multi-role deferred. |

## Local Notification Trigger Points

Requirements specify: 3-day and 7-day inactivity nudges, rescheduled on every app open.

| Trigger | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| 3-day inactivity | `NotificationService._idInactive3d` scheduled via `flutter_local_notifications` `zonedSchedule` with `AppConfig.inactivityNudge1` duration |
| 7-day inactivity | `NotificationService._idInactive7d` with `AppConfig.inactivityNudge2` |
| Reschedule on app open | `app.dart` `didChangeAppLifecycleState(resumed)` → `_rescheduleReminders()` → `cancelAll()` then re-schedule both |
| Opt-in trigger | `LevelCompleteScreen` (M-14) soft card after first ever level complete; `SettingsScreen` (M-27) toggle |
| Permission request | Only after user taps "Yes" — `NotificationService.requestPermission()`. No prompt at cold launch. |
| Under-13 | Same rules; local only, no PII in payload |
| Analytics | `local_notification_scheduled` (with trigger + current_level) and `local_notification_opened` (with trigger + entry_screen) |
| Deep-link resolution | No URL deep-links in v1; notification opens app to level map (tap callback routes to M-11 via `_onTap`). Cold-launch from notification detected via `getNotificationAppLaunchDetails()` in `SplashScreen.init()`. |

**Status: All v1 trigger points implemented at real call sites. No deep-link infrastructure required (spec §meta.notApplicable).**

## Design-Spec / Scaffold Mismatches Worth Noting

These are not gaps in critical flows, but minor divergences between the spec and implementation worth reviewing:

| # | Area | Note |
|---|------|------|
| M-1 | Admin tool | Design-spec §23 specifies AdminJS; scaffold uses **SQLAdmin** (Python-native equivalent). Functionally equivalent for all A-01–A-13 requirements. No coverage gap. |
| M-2 | FAQ content (M-31) | Design-spec OQ-07 resolves as "server-hosted" to allow correction without app store release. Implemented as `_FAQ_ITEMS` list hardcoded in `account.py` and served via `GET /v1/account/faq`. Server-hosted means FAQ copy can change on deploy, which satisfies the requirement. Content itself is a launch task for the team. |
| M-3 | Leaderboard scope | Design-spec OQ-05 leaves leaderboard scope open (global vs. church-group). Scaffold implements **global** (all users). No church-scoped grouping exists. If church-scoped leaderboard is required, a "join church" step and new leaderboard query are needed — not a current gap, but the open question remains unresolved in the code. |
| M-4 | Practice mode `LeaderboardEntry` exclusion | Practice attempts use `mode = practice`. Leaderboard query correctly filters to `ranked` mode only. Confirmed: no practice attempt can produce a leaderboard entry. |
| M-5 | Adaptive difficulty (analytics.personalization) | Design-spec notes adaptive difficulty as a personalization goal. No adaptive algorithm is implemented in v1. Level timer and difficulty tier are static per `Level` config. This is an open product question (OQ-08) not resolved as a code-level gap; it does not break any critical flow. |

## Conclusion

All 10 critical flows from `uxui.criticalFlows` and `qa.mustNotBreak` are **Connected**: every step has a corresponding screen or route, every screen is wired to the next step in its flow, and every handler behind those steps is executing real database reads, real store API calls, or real on-device logic rather than returning hardcoded responses or mock data.

The four `HANDOFF(Implementation Agent)` markers are correctly placed, clearly explained, and limited to: (a) real-money edge cases requiring policy decisions (IAP refund revocation, duplicate receipts, Google ACK timing) and (b) compliance verification against live third-party accounts (AdMob COPPA, VPC legal copy) — neither category is a silent stub, and neither blocks the happy-path flows that QA will exercise first.

**Implementation Agent should address before launch:**
1. **HANDOFF H-1** — Apple refund/revocation webhook + Google `products:acknowledge` (IAP edge cases)
2. **HANDOFF H-2** — Policy and admin tool for duplicate-receipt conflict
3. **HANDOFF H-3** — Live AdMob account COPPA audit (ad-unit settings, Play Families declaration, App Store age-rating)
4. **HANDOFF H-4** — Replace VPC email body and M-06B attestation form legal copy with counsel-reviewed text
5. **Unmarked TODO** — Replace splash screen placeholder icon with final brand asset (`splash_screen.dart` line 143)
6. **Content gap** — FAQ items in `account.py` are functional placeholder copy; final FAQ content authored by the team
7. **Open question M-3** — Confirm global leaderboard scope is acceptable or resolve OQ-05 before launch
